corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Steward owns artillery damage during actual eastern contact. Kroos contributes only when the airborne target is in range. Ansel sustains Steward; changing target selection is a new survival risk.

Kroos clears the eastern lower restraint; Spot intercepts pursuing hostiles. Final Kroos clears the western lower restraint. Arrival must be observed.

Midnight holds upper outer with two blocks, receiving Ansel healing during extended-range windows.
Spot holds lower outer with three blocks; Kroos supplies damage. Spot continues blocking while healing but stops ordinary attacks.

formation_structure.artillery_budget: At 470 ATK against 50 RES, an ordinary Steward hit contributes approximately 235 damage. The supported enhanced-hit cycle gives roughly 173 ideal DPS before contact gaps and competition. Approximately 75 seconds of exclusive contact are needed without other damage. From deployment at 69.033 seconds to withdrawal at 190 seconds, the plan therefore requires substantial effective contact, not merely elapsed time.

economy.income_dependencies: Fang must remain deployed and alive for grants around frames 570, 1320 and 2070. In particular, Ansel's deployment at 1231 uses the first grant. Failure is an opening survival failure.
economy.refund_dependency: No opening or later deployment requires a refund. Death gives zero refund.
economy.rotation_cost_basis: Use the supplied prior inspected current-model unchanged-cost behavior: Steward 18 per deployment and Kroos 11. Client cost escalation is not asserted.

formation_structure.execution_semantics: Timeline actions are fixed. Preconditions are assertions, not executable branches or waits. An unmet survival, clearance, or affordability assertion invalidates its dependent schedule.
formation_structure.medical_geometry: Ansel [5,5] DOWN covers Fang [3,5], Friston [4,5] and Steward [2,6]. His extended skill covers Midnight [1,5]. Spot [6,5] skill covers himself and Ansel [5,5], but not Kroos [5,7]. Kroos has no assigned healing at the eastern position.
formation_structure.mortality_policy: No death is required. A death may have contributed damage, blocking or absorbed attacks, but removes every subsequent assigned action and provides no refund. This fixed schedule contains no death-dependent redeployment branch.
formation_structure.output_geometry: Midnight RIGHT reaches the upper eastern restraint [1,6]. Kroos UP reaches the lower eastern restraint [6,6] and approaching lower-outer enemies. Spot's ordinary same-tile range does not reach that restraint. Steward UP from [2,6] covers the eastern patrol at column 7 through rows 2-4, but not [5,7]; the resulting contact gaps are explicitly charged against his artillery deadline.

Release Kroos only after lower-outer hostile clearance; Spot remains.
Release Steward only after all hostile enemies are dead and no hostile projectile remains.
Western restraint assignments are complete; continue observing protected arrivals.

remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected-target deaths and exactly two expected protected targets safely arrived. Record operator deaths separately.

revised_operational_plans.tactical_thesis: Replace the vulnerable lower duelist with Spot's three-block interception and intermittent healing. Use Kroos for lower restraint clearance and officer damage, position Ansel at [5,5] DOWN, and leave both historical failure tiles [5,6] and [5,3] empty. Steward attacks the eastern patrol from [2,6] UP under Ansel's ordinary coverage. This exchanges the failed shared-shell formation for a different, fully expressible seven-operator structure. Artillery contact, revised targeting, and lower restraint clearance remain unverified dependencies; this is a complete unsimulated hypothesis, not an established WIN.

revised_stage_understanding.changed_hypothesis: More healing at the old vulnerable positions was not a demonstrated repair. This revision eliminates both named artillery-exposure positions during the hostile artillery phase, replaces the lower one-block dependency with three blocks, and separates lower damage from lower blocking.
revised_stage_understanding.evidence_precedence: Verified prior_tactical_feedback governs the causal revision. Its reported [5,6] occupant conflicts with the prior plan's listed placement; do not silently reinterpret coordinates or claim that replayed occupancy follows the printed plan.

fact_classes.GameData: Catalog stats, ranges, skill charge parameters, routes and device positions.
fact_classes.UNKNOWN: New target ordering and splash outcomes, exact client equivalence, restraint destruction times, and whether the selected formation achieves enough artillery contact.
fact_classes.USER_CONFIRMED_TACTICAL_PREMISE: Attack occupation and deliberate sacrifice are authorized tactical possibilities, but ordinary pre-swing locking is not supplied as a model fact.
fact_classes.current_model: Neutral civilians are excluded from ordinary attacks and blocks; Spot healing is approximated and stops his attacks; artillery projectiles retain locked impact points; manual actions are deploy, skill and retreat.

candidates.bait_retreat_sacrifice: No attack-bait timing or required sacrifice. Rotations occur only after asserted local clearance; they do not cancel projectiles.
candidates.cost: 139 gross deployment DP across the full plan; up to 23 conditional living-refund DP. Lower tanking improves, but caster contact and Kroos survival remain unverified.
candidates.most_dangerous_window: Frames 2071-3783: revised artillery targeting, unhealed Kroos, incomplete restraint damage and Spot's first inactive healing gap.
candidates.opening_cost_and_pressure: 92 gross first-deployment DP. Fang 0, Friston 91, Midnight 571, Spot 901, Ansel 1231, Kroos 1591, Steward 2071. Medical coverage starts at 41.033 seconds; Spot's first skill is scheduled at 61.067 seconds, after its 45.033-second readiness.
candidates.same_phase_responsibilities: Four blockers, one permanent medic, one lower physical output and one artillery/armor caster. Spot fuses lower blocking with intermittent healing.
candidates.selection_reason: Selected because it removes the failed lower-duelist survival dependency and uses supported blocking, healing and output mechanics with a complete seven-ID stage schedule. Selection is a tactical hypothesis, not a static proof of feasibility.
candidates.staged_responsibilities: Steward rotates to lower armor after artillery clearance; Kroos and Steward later clear opposite western restraints.

candidates.bait_retreat_sacrifice: No sacrifice required. Sustained tanking must survive actual delivered heals, not summed nominal HPS.
candidates.cost: Persistent medical coverage consumes two roster slots and delays arts. Moving Hibiscus to [2,5] UP can cover central units but loses ordinary coverage of Melantha [6,5]; retaining [5,3] repeats a verified fatal footprint.
candidates.most_dangerous_window: Frames 1681-2381, before Hibiscus's first skill and during repeated artillery impacts.
candidates.opening_cost_and_pressure: 96 gross first-deployment DP. Independently recomputed order: Fang 0, Friston 91, Midnight 571, Melantha 841, Ansel 1171, Hibiscus 1681, Steward 2071. Ansel precedes Hibiscus; Hibiscus cannot boost until approximately frame 2581.
candidates.same_phase_responsibilities: Fang and Friston central; Midnight and Melantha outer; two medics sustain four blockers and Steward.
candidates.selection_reason: Not selected: available medical geometry does not establish simultaneous lower-duelist survival and artillery-unit survival. The verified deaths invalidate assuming an extra medic alone repairs the structure.
candidates.staged_responsibilities: Steward rotates from artillery to armor; Melantha and Steward finish western restraints.

candidates.cost: Yato costs 7 initially; supported redeploy delta gives 40 seconds. Living retreat refunds 3 under the supplied floor-half convention; death refunds zero. A same-ID return still requires its actual runtime fee. Spot costs 17 and needs 15 seconds after deployment to begin healing.
candidates.exact_gap: No supported action expresses ordinary pre-swing target commitment or a conditional retreat keyed to that commitment. Replacing it with a completed-strike handoff is checkable, but removes the claimed damage-free opening bridge.
candidates.most_dangerous_window: The first central officer handoff and the late first medic. Without Fang, opening survival and deadlines must be solved independently.
candidates.opening_cost_and_pressure: 103 gross initial deployment DP without refunds. Natural-only milestones: Yato and Friston frame 0, Midnight 481, Melantha 931, Ansel 1441, Steward 1981, Spot 2791. These are affordability milestones, not proof that delayed outer interception survives.

raw_bait_plan.beneficiary: Spot gains setup time and Steward gains attack time.
raw_bait_plan.current_model_fact: Ordinary targeting occurs at ATTACK_STRIKE; only a completed attack reliably preserves its cooldown across target changes.
raw_bait_plan.decoy_survival: Yato must remain alive until the attack has actually struck her if cooldown consumption is to be established.
raw_bait_plan.enemy_and_attack: enemy_1107_uoffcr ordinary 330-ATK melee attack with 2-second base interval.
raw_bait_plan.residual_risk: The released officer remains active; a pre-strike retreat may redirect the strike to Spot or a civilian. Artillery projectiles remain independent.
raw_bait_plan.successor: Spot enters after Yato's retreat with enough DP and before the released officer reaches a civilian or bypasses the block.
raw_bait_plan.user_confirmed_assumption: A pre-swing committed attack remains occupied by its original target while Yato withdraws.

candidates.same_phase_responsibilities: Yato supplies temporary central interception and attack bait; Friston lower central, Midnight upper outer, Melantha lower outer, Ansel healing, Steward artillery damage; Spot succeeds a pressured blocker.
candidates.selection_reason: Not selected: the decisive bait assumption is not expressible, and the natural-only opening leaves unresolved interception and medical delays. Its raw tactic is retained rather than rewritten into a favorable mechanic.
candidates.staged_responsibilities: Retreat Yato after an officer commits to attacking her, then deploy Spot into the released interception job. Rotate Melantha and Steward to final restraints.

required_repair_card.number_16_observable: Before frame 4070, identify enemy_1107_uoffcr#16 by its actual route and observe its death or continuing interception with a living blocker and no bypass. Spawn-number assumptions do not substitute for this event.
required_repair_card.released_work: Melantha is omitted. Spot owns lower blocking and self-sustain; Kroos owns lower restraint damage and queue acceleration. No mid-shell replacement is required.
required_repair_card.survival_claim: Empty historical tiles remove those occupants, not the attack or splash. Newly selected impact points must be inspected; surrounding units are not declared immune.

revised_strategic_hypotheses.hypothesis: Separating lower blocking from lower damage, replacing the fragile lower duelist with Spot, and vacating both historical failure tiles can preserve interception long enough for Steward to kill artillery and later close armor queues.
revised_strategic_hypotheses.support: The previous persistent-duelist and exposed-medical arrangement demonstrably failed. The replacement uses supported three-block interception, Spot healing, basic ranged output and legal rotations.

decisive_checks: Opening blockers survive until Ansel at frame 1231 and all credited Fang grants actually occur.
Both eastern restraints fall before nearby officers can kill their waiting civilians.
Kroos survives revised artillery selection without assigned healing.
Steward accumulates enough actual artillery damage before frame 5700; civilian survival is required throughout, not merely at that deadline.
Spot's healing allocation preserves himself and Ansel without overflowing the lower queue.
Officer #16 does not leak at or before its historical frame 4070.
Central queues remain contained during Steward's withdrawal; #34 is killed before final clearance rotation.
Final device destruction produces two observed safe arrivals.
revised_tactical_requirements.failure_handling: An unmet assertion is a counterexample to this fixed plan. Do not silently delay actions, credit dead-unit output, add an eighth operator or declare success from the timeline horizon.
revised_tactical_requirements.verification_status: Static tactical proposal only. No files changed, simulation run or external provider invoked.
revised_tactical_requirements.win_requirement: remaining_life > 0; zero leaks; exhausted spawn schedule; no active enemies.

revision_hypothesis.if_expected_event_absent: Reject the opening handoff and inspect actual DP, Fang survival, occupancy and deployment validity. Do not substitute later income or actions on dead operators. Successful deployment alone does not verify the subsequent survival or full-stage hypothesis.
revision_hypothesis.tactical_hypothesis: Replacing the lower duelist with Spot, assigning restraint and officer damage to Kroos, and vacating the two historical failure tiles should remove the demonstrated same-position death chain while retaining all four interceptions and a full clearance schedule.
